title: Version 17.14.18
body_markdown:
*Released October 20th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| The XAML editor will no longer mark nested classes as an error within {x:Static} and {x:Type} markup extensions. For example, {x:Static p:Class+Nested.Value} would be squiggled as an error even when it's valid. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Intellisense-net-MAUI-XAML-Markup-x:st/10975607) |
| Spell checker should split words between Lo and Ll/Lu categories | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Spell-checker-should-split-words-between/10961871) |
| In Visual Studio 17.14.13, .NET C# error squiggles are not showing in Blend | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/New-version-171413-visual-studio-mist/10961267) |
| New Visual Studio 2022 Updates Include LibCurl Library that Breaks Git | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/New-Visual-Studio-2022-Updates-Include-L/10965826) |
| Visual Studio 2022 Enterprise - Not able to open App Service .diagsession files | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-Enterprise---Not-able/10957454) |
| Disabled usage of FP as a general purpose register on ARM64. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/ARM64VC-1714-URGENT:-FP-register-be/10929794) |
| Updated the Visual Studio Installer to include the latest servicing release of the 10.0.26100 Windows SDK (10.0.26100.6584). |  |
| Fixed a bad interaction with new pre-vector optimizations and the vectorizer pass (affects any optimized code /O2). |  |
| Fixed unresolved external error while building ARM64X DLLs containing forwarded data. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/arm64x-forwarding-dll-does-not-support-D/10954319) |
| PGO instrumentation runtime crash on ARM64 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/PGO-instrumentation-runtime-crash-on-ARM/10949293) |
